title: Protest Is Hallmark Of Democracy: Madras High Court Quashes Case Against Farmer For Hunger Strike
description: The Madras High Court recently quashed criminal cases lodged against an agriculturist for holding a hunger strike against the continuous lodging of criminal cases against their Farmers' Association leader. [2026 LiveLaw (Mad) 326] Justice M Nirmal Kumar observed that there was no material to show that the persons had caused any inconvenience to the general public.
